source: The game's own CharacterPowerCalculator, called in game for 616 owned Invokers (LootDump F11 power probe); formula fitted and checked against every one.

formula.skill: average upgrade level of ActiveSkill1-3, Ultimate and Combo (the levels stored in the box, i.e. upgrades done, max 10), divided by 10. Tolerance and Passive skills are ignored.
formula.nodes: number of unlocked awakening nodes that are not a level's root node (node id % 100 != 1), divided by 60
formula.maxError: multiplier reproduced within 4e-6 for all 616 Invokers

unconfirmed: Which stats feed ATK/DEF/HP: the probe's power (gamePowerWithoutGear) was computed by the game with no gear bonuses. If the collection screen's number is higher, it also counts gear/accessory stats; compare one card (e.g. a 6-star level 60 Invoker) to confirm.
The 0.97667 base was measured (identical for every Invoker), not read from config.
